digest.component_or_area: rebar-implement skill and shared test-design documentation
propositions: Five prose upgrades to implement-side skill and test-design target escape classes: parity siblings, config read-but-miswired, op-level contention semantics, gate findings without oracle upgrades, and known residual gaps.
Surface-parity census (4a) must enumerate five slots (CLI, MCP-API, library-facade, automated-callers, dual-direction) and disposition each as in-scope-proven or out-of-scope-with-reason.
Config-effect contrast (test-design §6) requires one test per config key proving behavior change through real read path (default vs non-default), not just parsing.

Contention triggers (4b) route by operation shape to existing shared suites: composed/check-then-act writes to two_clones fixture, write-storm/retry to storm suite, read-integrity-under-contention to sync_contention_harness.
Gate-finding behavioral fixes require RED test first in same change, then implementation; non-behavioral fixes may proceed directly.
Phase-5 residual-gap disposition sweep enumerates items as filed, accepted-with-reason, or fixed, using forced-artifact wording.
